label: Paint Splatter
blurb: Blobs of wet paint are thrown at the frame one after another and the incoming shot arrives inside them. Each splat lands with a ragged edge that is never the same twice, swells out past its final size and settles back, and throws a scatter of small droplets ahead of itself. Give it a paint colour and the blobs land as flat colour first and then clear to the picture underneath, like a real paint wipe. Set how many splats there are, how big they get, and how far the droplets fly.
